interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A synthetic repository, ordered-parent, merge-topology, tree, path-mode, blob, diff, review-disposition, approval, owner-scope, thread, rereview, correction, and current-lineage control separating one complete-looking public surface from eight incompatible custody states.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real repository review, code review, source audit, build audit, artifact verification, security finding, interval-validity finding, causal effect, graph fact, allegation, or public-authority verdict.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Verified-looking repository, review-commit, review-scope, review-disposition, and owner-scope badges do not establish immutable repository identity, parent order, merge topology, complete path-mode and blob denominators, complete diff, current thread state, owner resolution, invalidation, rereview, correction, or current lineage.

worlds.description: Repository identity, ordered parents, merge topology, trees, complete path-mode and blob scope, full diff, review disposition, approvals, owner scope, invalidation, rereview, correction, and current lineage are complete.
Public repository and review-commit badges remain while immutable repository identity, canonical location, release, or the review-time commit is substituted or incomplete.
The review commit label is preserved while ordered parents, merge topology, merge base, source tree, release tree, or current-main ancestry differs.
The review-scope badge is preserved while paths, normalization, modes, symlinks, binary or LFS classification, blobs, ignored/generated policies, deletions, renames, or copies are incomplete.
One visible diff is preserved while base, head, merge base, binary changes, generated outputs, exclusions, unchanged dependencies, or the complete path denominator remain unbound.
The review-disposition badge is preserved while requested changes, dismissals, overrides, review-time commit binding, thread census, inline context, or comment mutation custody is incomplete.

The owner-scope badge is preserved while approval scope, reviewer conflicts, CODEOWNERS identity, per-path owner resolution, owner denominator, branch protection, or required-review policy is incomplete.

Historical repository and review assurance is inherited after repository, branch, commit, parent, tree, path, blob, diff, reviewer, owner, policy, correction, release, or use succession without complete invalidation and rereview.
